about.title: About Make Anyth.ing
about.lede: A small 3D printing studio in Hong Kong, making useful, beautiful objects close to where they are used.
about.story_title: Made near you, not on a container ship
about.story: Most things we buy travel thousands of kilometres before they reach us. A 3D print can be made in an afternoon, repaired when a part breaks, and adjusted to fit the exact shelf you have. We print on demand at our Hong Kong pickup points, using filament we can trace, and keep the models small enough that nothing sits in a warehouse waiting for a buyer.
about.value_local: Printing happens at the pickup point near you. No air freight, no plastic film wrapped around a box inside another box.
about.value_craft: We would rather print one bracket that fits than a shelf full of things that almost do. Tell us the dimensions and we will work from them.
about.value_open: Community designs sit alongside our own, with creators earning a share of every print sold.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.lede: Questions about an order, a material, or a part that needs to fit exactly right? Send a message and a real person will reply.
contact.sign_in_hint: Sign in to send a message. It becomes a support ticket you can follow, and we can see your past orders.
contact.subject: Subject
contact.sent: Thanks — your message is ticket “{{subject}}”. We reply in the ticket and by email.
contact.required: Add a subject and a message.
contact.ticket_hint: Your message opens a support ticket, so nothing gets lost in an inbox.
contact.email_hint: Write to us directly and we will answer within one working day.
contact.hours_hint: Opening hours vary by pickup point — call ahead if you are collecting a large order.

careers.title: Careers
careers.lede: We are a small team of makers, printers, and people who like fixing things. When a role opens, it appears here.
careers.hidden_body: We are not hiring through this page at the moment. If you would like to introduce yourself anyway, use the contact page and tell us what you make.
careers.no_roles_hint: Check back soon, or send us a message and we will keep your details on file.
careers.apply_body: Email your CV and a short note about something you have made or fixed. We read every application ourselves.
